response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS cnt FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_avg AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt) AS city_avg FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), kept AS (SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.cnt, a.city_avg FROM rep_counts r JOIN city_avg a ON a.City IS r.City WHERE r.cnt > a.city_avg), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM rep_counts) SELECT k.City AS city, SUM(k.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(k.cnt - k.city_avg) AS avg_above_city_avg, AVG(1.0 * k.cnt / t.total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total FROM kept k CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY k.City;
